items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: Ransom, New Orleans. I got him out of Vicksburg, Mississippi.

ctx.x: He's in Chicago. Yeah, it seems like I heard of him. This is a guy here. I picked him up in Mississippi somewhere. The trombone player by the name of Moran. And later years he played with, what, let's see. I think of the name of the And this is Eugene Ware. That's a trumpet player. That's the one that got stranded with one of those shows in New Orleans and I hired him to play in my band. He's in Indianapolis now. And this is Marcel. I got him out of Detroit. Singer. That's me in my picture. And this is New…
Louis Nelson wasn't in that group.
